title: Top Running Shoes for Daily Miles & Race Day (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were selected based on recommendations from Outside Online, which tested 63 road running shoes over thousands of miles. Other sources like RTINGS, Tom's Guide, CNET, Wired, and Fleet Feet were reviewed for context, but specific product rankings were primarily derived from Outside Online's 2026 update.
assumptions: Prices are only included if explicitly stated in the source text. The Mizuno Wave Rider 30 is noted at $150. No other prices are provided in the excerpts.
